## Import diagnoses

```{r import_diagnoses}
# Time: 8 mins (ErisOne)
# Time: 1.8 mins (awing)
# Time: 3 mins (Elyn)
system.time({
  df = fread(paste0(dir_rpdrml, "RPDRml__DX.txt"),
             # This could be all rows or a sample of rows.
             nrows = sample_rows) 
})

# 570 MM rows
dim(df)

class(df)

names(df)
```

## Load unshift file

```{r load_unshift_file}
# Hyunjoon received from Victor and shared with Chris via MGB Dropbox.
unshift_df = fread(here("data-raw/RPDRml_v2024_1_empi_map.csv"))

str(unshift_df)

# 3 - 12 days
table(unshift_df$random_offset)

# Left join relative to df.
# Time: 106 seconds (awing)
# Time: 84 secs (Elyn)
system.time({
  df = merge(df, unshift_df, by = "subject_num", all.x = TRUE)
})

# 1.5% appear to be missing the random offset (& other fields) right now.
mean(is.na(df$empi))
# only 1,033 records are missing empi - not too shabby.
sum(is.na(df$empi))

# Remove records missing empi.
df = df[!is.na(empi)]

# Still 570 MM rows.
dim(df)

# Clean up
rm(unshift_df)
```

## Clean start date

```{r clean_start_date}

# No missing values
sum(is.na(df$random_offset))

# Incorporate the random offset from RPDR-ML
# If it is missing, we'll get a missing value for sstart_date.
# CK 2022-10-22: it appears that we should add rather than subtract the random offset.
df[, sstart_date := lubridate::mdy(sstart_date) + random_offset]

# Range: Jan. 1, 1998 to Nov. 25, 2022
summary(df$sstart_date)
```


## Link ICD codes to PheCodes

```{r link_phecodes}

dx_dict = fread(paste0(dir_rpdrml, "RPDRml__DX_dictionary.txt"))

names(dx_dict) = tolower(names(dx_dict))

# Remove extra cols before we merge.
set(dx_dict, , c("concept_path", "concept_ontology", "concept_type"), NULL)

# Contains the PheCode
head(dx_dict)

key(dx_dict)
key(df)


if (FALSE) {
  # This is crashing R/RStudio for some reason.
system.time({
  setkey(dx_dict, concept_code)
})

  # This will take a bit.
  system.time({
    setkeyv(df, c("subject_num", "concept_code"))
  })
}


# Join to DX data based on concept_code
# Time: 5 secs
system.time({
  df2 = merge(df, dx_dict, by = "concept_code",
                # We still want icd10 codes for comorbidity score calculation.
                # Concept name will allow grouping phecodes, e.g. for dementia
          #.(subject_num, sstart_date, icd10_code, phecode, concept_code, concept_name),
          # Right outer join - all rows in df, per
          # https://stackoverflow.com/questions/12773822/why-does-xy-join-of-data-tables-not-allow-a-full-outer-join-or-a-left-join
          all.x = TRUE)
})

dim(df2)
df = df2

names(df)

rm(df2, dx_dict)

# We have 1,848 unique phecodes.
length(unique(df$phecode))

# Compared to 44,782 unique ICD codes.
length(unique(df$concept_code))

# 3.6 MM are missing phecode - may be an internal MGB code for example.
sum(is.na(df$phecode))

str(df)

# Remove rows missing phecode.
# This will drop "Epic reason for visit" (ERFV), and possibly other concept types.
#df = df %>% filter(!is.na(phecode))

nrow(df)

# # All diagnoses
# table(df$concept_type)


# # TODO: research & describe what these other ontologies mean.
# table(df$concept_ontology, "has_phecode" = as.integer(!is.na(df$phecode)))
# 
# table(df[is.na(phecode), concept_ontology])
```




## Remove extra cols

```{r remove_extra_cols}
# Remove cols: warning arrive if certain columns are not present. We won't require them if they are incorporated in future datasets, so it's ok to keep the list as is
remove_cols = c("concept_path", "biobank_subject_id", "random_offset", "concept_type",
                "epic_fhir_ws", "site")

# This line will show a warning in RStudio but we are intentionally leaving the row argument empty.
data.table::set(df, , remove_cols, NULL)
```



## Save dx dataset

```{r save_dataset}
str(df)

system.time({
  fst::write.fst(df,
                 here(paste0("data/rpdrml-", conf$rpdrml_version, "/diagnoses.fst")))
})

# Clean up RAM
gc()
```
